name: Bubble Nibbler Hideout
intro: A trail of shimmering bubbles leads toward a coral burrow tucked beneath Moonlit Reef. Tiny bite marks cover the shells around its entrance, and something deeper inside makes an unmistakable nom nom nom sound.

entrance.prompt: A trail of suspiciously perfect bubbles disappears into the coral burrow. Tiny bite marks cover the shells around the entrance, and something deeper inside makes an unmistakable nom nom nom sound. Three passages wind farther into the hideout.

left.message: You follow a trail of shimmering bubbles into a tiny storage nook. Someone—or something—has carefully stacked shells around a pouch of Star Candies. The bite marks on the pouch suggest you arrived just in time.

forward.message: A bubble-shaped shell cup holds one Berry beside a note in Shizuki's handwriting: "Emergency snack! NOT FOR THE BUBBLE NIBBLERS. They already ate the first cup. And part of my map. Little criminals."

inner-crossing.prompt: The burrow opens into three shell-lined tunnels. Hundreds of tiny bubbles drift through the water, occasionally carrying things that definitely do not belong in bubbles—a spoon, a button, half a map, and what appears to be somebody's sock.

right.message: Behind a coral shelf, you discover one of Shizuki's abandoned camps. An empty berry pouch, a chewed corner of a map, and one surviving bottle remain. Its label reads: "Tastes terrible. Works anyway. If you're wondering what the green part is, don't."
right.fullHpMessage: Shizuki's suspicious green remedy is still waiting beside the chewed map. Fortunately, being completely healthy gives you an excellent excuse not to drink it.

forward.message: A stream of bubbles leads to a pile of stolen trinkets wedged beneath a shell. Most are completely useless, but buried among the collection is a valuable cache. Apparently Bubble Nibblers have excellent taste in valuables.

coral-maze.prompt: The tunnels narrow into a twisting coral maze absolutely covered in tiny bite marks. Scraps of shells, maps, ribbons, and other stolen treasures have been tucked into every crevice. Whatever lives here has apparently been collecting things for a very long time.

left.message: You discover the hideout's largest stash tucked inside a pearl-lined hollow. Buttons, polished shells, shiny rocks, one completely useless fork—and beneath all of it, a cache of Star Candies.

right.message: Another weathered Shizuki field kit is wedged high in the coral, apparently placed somewhere the Bubble Nibblers couldn't reach. One bottle remains labeled: "Second recipe. Less terrible. Still green. Progress!"
right.fullHpMessage: The second green bottle is still safely tucked away. You are at full health, which means you have once again escaped having to find out what Shizuki put in it.

boss-antechamber.name: Boss Antechamber
boss-antechamber.prompt: The maze opens into a huge chamber overflowing with stolen junk. Shells. Spoons. Maps. Buttons. Star Candies. At the center sits an enormous bubble-shaped nest. A single gigantic bite mark has been taken out of the coral beside it.

bossPromptDiscord:
A thunderous NOM echoes through the chamber.

The mountain of stolen treasures begins to shake. Something very large is chewing behind it.

Use /yes to investigate or /no to decide that whatever made that bite mark can keep its snacks.
bossPromptTwitch:
A thunderous NOM echoes through the chamber.

The mountain of stolen treasures begins to shake. Something very large is chewing behind it.

Use !yes to investigate or !no to decide that whatever made that bite mark can keep its snacks.
bossRetreatText: You quietly back away from the suspiciously moving treasure pile. Another enormous NOM echoes behind you. Whatever lives here can keep the fork.

boss.revealText: The treasure pile EXPLODES into bubbles. An enormous Bubble Nibbler bursts from underneath with a stolen pouch in its mouth. The Bubble Nibbler Boss has apparently decided you are interrupting snack time.

completionText: The Bubble Nibbler Boss bursts into a harmless storm of silver bubbles, scattering its stolen collection across the chamber. Among the shells, buttons, spoons, and thoroughly chewed maps, you uncover the path leading deeper into Moonlit Reef. Somewhere behind you, one last tiny Bubble Nibbler steals the useless fork and disappears.
